 Veterans Day County Service Changes: What Imperial Beach Residents Should Know
 County offices, libraries and public health facilities will close Nov. 11, while emergency services continue throughout the holiday.
 Doc Louallen , Patch Staff 
 Posted Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 12:17 pm PT IMPERIAL BEACH, CA — Imperial Beach residents who need county government services should plan ahead as San Diego County prepares to close several public facilities Wednesday, Nov. 11, for Veterans Day.
 The county announced that government offices, family resource centers, county-operated libraries, public health centers and animal shelters will close in observance of the federal holiday.
 Residents seeking in-person assistance with county programs or public health services are encouraged to complete their visits before Wednesday or schedule appointments after the holiday.
 Find out what's happening in Imperial Beach for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . County parks and campgrounds will remain open during regular operating hours, although certain recreation offices and community centers will close.
 Law enforcement, emergency animal control response and other essential county services will continue operating during the holiday.
 Find out what's happening in Imperial Beach for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . Normal county business hours are scheduled to resume Thursday, Nov. 12.
 Veterans Day is observed annually Nov. 11 to honor those who have served in the United States military.
 Residents can check facility information and county service updates through the County of San Diego website .
 City-operated facilities and services may follow separate holiday schedules, and residents should check with the city of Imperial Beach before visiting municipal offices.
